notes.title: Updates and Bug Fixes - August 14th, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you to everyone who’s played [i]Ryder[/i] so far! [/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback (and combing through bug reports) and have just pushed a new update live with the following changes:[/p][p][b]Performance & Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new settings to help optimize performance for your specific system[/p][/*][*][p]Improved runtime performance across all levels[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more spawners for late-level creatures to make finding their variants easier[/p][/*][*][p]Increased interaction circles for larger creatures to make bonding smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the ability to jump over Secret Key and Collectible gates (sorry! you’ll need to unlock them the proper way now)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted puzzle gates so they can’t be used to drop into unintended areas[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a few puzzles that were not caching the correct solve state[/p][/*][/list][p]We’d love to keep hearing from you. Join our community on Discord to share your favorite creatures, swap tips, and chat with us:
[u][url="https://discord.gg/pXRQzmJmB2"]Join the Discord[/url]
[/u][/p][p]If you’ve been enjoying [i]Ryder[/i], leaving a review on Steam is one of the best ways to help more people discover the game. We appreciate your support so much![/p][p]Thank you for playing,
Elle & Arlin[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re thrilled to finally share the news: [b]Ryder will be released on August 6, 2025[/b] on Steam.[/p][p]This cozy creature-collecting puzzle adventure has been a passion project for years. We can't wait for you to experience the full journey. Solve puzzles, bring creatures back into the world, and explore regions filled with life and wonder.[/p][p]If you tried the demo, thank you. Your feedback and support have helped us make the game even better.[/p][p]In the meantime, make sure to [b]wishlist Ryder[/b] so you’ll be among the first to know when it goes live.

🗓️ [b]August 6th[/b] — mark your calendars![/p]

notes.title: Ryder Is Live in Steam Next Fest – With a Special Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, friends![/p][p]We’re excited to share that [i]Ryder[/i] is officially live in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and we’ve released a [b]special demo update[/b] just for the event![/p][p]For this week only, you can:
🔹 Solve a brand new puzzle
🔹 Meet a brand new creature
🔹 Discover [b]limited-time variants[/b] of existing creatures—hidden throughout the world[/p][p]If you’ve played the demo before, now’s the perfect time to revisit it. And if you’re new to Ryder, welcome! This is a non-violent, creature-collecting puzzle adventure where every puzzle solved brings a new creature back into the world—and slowly restores life to the land.[/p][p]Later this week, we’ll also be announcing [b]Ryder’s release date[/b], so stay tuned for that reveal![/p][p]Until then, we’d love to hear what you think of the update—and if you manage to find any of the special variants, feel free to post them and tag us. We may even highlight a few in a future post on our social channels![/p][p]Thanks so much for the support, and happy exploring!
—Arlin & Elle[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278192/ca4d2e29a7d5f5b9ca7acd2a6e6d23ca10b19f16.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Ryder Demo Just Got an Update!
notes.notes:
Thanks so much to everyone who played the first version of the Ryder demo and sent us your thoughts—it’s been amazing to hear from you!

We’ve just pushed [b]an update[/b] that focuses on streamlining the experience and adding more of what makes Ryder fun. Here’s what’s new:

Puzzle flow is faster and smoother—less backtracking, quicker start, more polished creature selection process
[list]
[*] Creatures are faster and more responsive
[*] You can now try out actual creature abilities in the demo! You'll get to try the wind burst and wind jump mechanics
[*] Improved framerate, bug fixes, and better UI behavior
[*] The creatures have eyes now. 👀
[*] If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now’s a great time! You’ll explore a peaceful autumnal forest, solve 7 puzzles (4 new from previous version), and meet 5 playable creatures (3 new from previous version).
[/list]

Additionally, here is Elle, the Creative Director, explaining Ryder in detail:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qFiOGMiOYb8]Everything You Need to Know About Ryder[/url]

Don’t forget to Wishlist and Follow us to stay in the loop!

[b]Important Note: Unfortunately at this time the Ryder Demo will not be playable on Steam Deck. We are working to resolve the issue and we hope to support it soon! f you run into any other issues, please let us know via [url=https://forms.gle/VMxZoxf9cCuY7C3W8]this Google Form.[/url] And come chat with us in [url=https://discord.gg/9v6M4h9G]the Discord[/url]—we’d love to hear what you think![/b]

Thanks again for supporting our little game.

— Arlin and Elle
Yellow Tree Games
